title: A Portrait for the Autopsy
author: S. M. Crane
blurb: Ines Ashgrove, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
